title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
headline: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 4 Argon with Safety Stack
summary: Google DeepMind has released its frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, providing developers and enterprises access via API, Google Antigravity, and the Gemini app. The model features extensive capabilities across coding, science, cyber defense, and complex workflows. Google deployed a comprehensive safety and security stack, including misuse and jailbreak defenses under its Frontier Safety Framework, agent alignment monitoring, and indirect prompt injection mitigations.
why_it_matters: Organisations deploying advanced agentic models must implement rigorous multi-layer defense stacks, including automated runtime misalignment monitors and frontier safety evaluations, to mitigate risks such as unauthorized shortcuts and prompt injection.

quotes.text: Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available today for developers and enterprises via the API in AI Studio and Gemini platform , for Google AI Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity , and Google AI Ultra and Pro subscribers in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search .

Under our Frontier Safety Framework, we evaluated Argon’s enhanced capabilities across several domains, and deployed a multi-layer defense stack combining jailbreak resistance, monitoring, and enforcement.

classification.significance_reason: Introduction of a major frontier model release detailing advanced safety, agent alignment, and red-teaming methodologies under a Frontier Safety Framework.
